title: fix(service-settings): the Setup settings pages name the organization or the environment, not a workspace
body:
Fixes #24142

Clause-②: no

The Setup settings pages said 「工作区名称」 and 「此工作区」 (and "workspace", ワークスペース, espacio de trabajo in the other locales). This PR applies the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#2939, letter A (ruling `6229029648`), to the built-in settings manifests and their four locale bundles. The ruling, as the card quotes it: one noun, 「组织」, for the thing members and billing belong to, and 「环境」 for the running instance. 「工作区」 retires.

## The deciding fact: which plane reads which manifest

The control plane and a tenant environment both mount `SettingsServicePlugin` with the same `builtinSettingsManifests`, and the plugin loads the same `settingsBuiltinTranslations` on both. **No field in a manifest tells the two planes apart.** The only scope field is `SettingsManifest.scope` (`global` / `tenant` / `user`), which is the storage rung, not a plane.

Per-plane wording is not needed, though. That `scope` already says what each setting belongs to, and it means the same thing on both planes because one `SettingsService` stores both:

- **`tenant` = one row per organization.** `sys_setting`'s row identity is `(organization_id, namespace, key, scope, user_id)`, and `settings-organization-isolation.pin.test.ts` pins one organization's write leaving another's alone. That holds in a tenant environment as well as on the control plane. These strings now say **organization**.
- **`global` = one row for the running instance.** These strings now say **environment**. The auth page's audience copy already used that noun ("Who may become a user of this environment's apps").

So each string's noun follows its manifest's existing `scope`, and no new key or plane switch was added. On the control plane this agrees with the card ("the organisation on the control plane's settings"). For a tenant environment it differs from the card in one place: Branding, Company and Feature Flags say **organization** there too, not environment, because those values are stored per organization in an environment as well. On the control plane, Mail and SMS say **environment**, which names the control plane's own running instance. Both readings are the ruling's definitions applied to where each value is stored. If a reviewer reads the ruling differently for either plane, that is the one judgement in this PR to check.

## What each string says now

| Where | scope | en | zh-CN | ja-JP | es-ES |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Branding, name field label | tenant | Organization name | 组织名称 | 組織名 | Nombre de la organización |
| Branding description | tenant | Organization name, logo, and accent colour. | 组织名称、Logo 与主题色。 | 組織名・ロゴ・アクセントカラー。 | Nombre de la organización, logotipo y color de acento. |
| Company, legal-name help | tenant | … (may differ from the organization name set under Branding). | …(可能与「品牌」中的组织名称不同)。 | …（「ブランディング」の組織名と異なる場合があります）。 | … (puede diferir del nombre de la organización indicado en Marca). |
| Feature Flags description | tenant | … for this organization. | 为当前组织… | この組織で… | … para esta organización. |
| Mail, Provider section | global | Choose how this environment sends outbound email. | 选择此环境如何发送邮件。 | この環境の送信方法を選択します。 | Elige cómo envía correo saliente este entorno. |
| SMS, Provider section | global | Choose how this environment sends outbound SMS. (manifest literal; `en.ts` has no `sms` block) | 选择此环境如何发送外发短信。 | この環境が送信 SMS をどう送るかを選択します。 | Elige cómo envía este entorno los SMS salientes. |
| Auth, New user membership help | global | … creating an organization, … | 自行创建组织 | 組織の作成 | crear una organización |

Per-locale nouns: zh-CN 组织 / 环境, ja-JP 組織 / 環境, es-ES organización / entorno. The membership help's "creating a workspace" is the explicit act of creating an organization: ADR-0093 D1's "personal workspace per signup" is the cloud's personal-org hook. The Company help names Branding, because "may differ from the organization name" on the organization's own legal-name field reads as circular without saying where that name is set.

## What did not change

- **No key.** `branding.workspace_name`, its `OS_BRANDING_WORKSPACE_NAME` override, every other setting key, and every key in the four bundles keep their spelling. No translation bundle key was renamed or deleted, so `PlatformTranslationData` keeps its shape (`Clause-②: no` holds).
- **The hub `category` value `'Workspace'`** (branding, company, localization) stays. It is a lookup key, not copy: objectui's `SettingsHub` reads `console.settingsHub.categories.` plus that value and translates the section header in its own bundles, which already render it as Environment / 环境 / 環境 / Entorno. Renaming it would move the console's key. The console is out of scope here (objectstack-ai/objectui#12851 is the sibling).
- Code comments and test fixtures that say "workspace" are not user-facing and were left alone.

## The pin

`src/settings-retired-workspace-noun.pin.test.ts` walks every string of every built-in manifest except the properties a machine reads (identifiers, storage keys, stored values, permissions, expressions, handler wiring and `category`; listed in `NOT_COPY`). A copy field added later is therefore covered without editing the list. The pin also walks every value of the en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES bundles. It finds no `workspace` (as a word, so `workspace_name` and `OS_BRANDING_WORKSPACE_NAME` named in prose are not hits), 工作区, ワークスペース or espacio de trabajo. Non-vacuity checks: the walk must reach each manifest's label and every specifier and option label, each bundle must yield more than 100 strings, and each bundle must reach `settings.branding.keys.workspace_name.label` as a path. The detector's own positive and negative controls run in the first case.

**Ablation (one, as the lane commits).** At `942717ff9`, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` planted `工作区名称` back into the zh-CN Branding label (anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `568263dfa148` → `10719672d7c8`). The pin went red as expected, `Tests 1 failed | 15 passed (16)`, on exactly:

```text
zh-CN.settings.branding.keys.workspace_name.label (工作区): 工作区名称
```

Restore proven by the tool: blob after restore == HEAD blob (`568263dfa148`) and `git diff HEAD` empty. Re-read afterwards: 0 hits of 工作区 in the file, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes.

## Verification

The package build, test and typecheck ran at `942717ff9`. The final commit `e594280be` adds only the changeset, so no package file differs between the two. The derived gates ran at `e594280be`.

- Closure build: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/service-settings^...' build` gave VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test` passed: `Test Files 48 passed (48)`, `Tests 861 passed (861)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) gave exit 0, and `--listFiles` includes the new pin (1 hit).
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against merge base `8a88901be` derived 63 commands. 62 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (it needs every package's `dist/`), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and is left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: `63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
- `test:repo` was not run locally (CI's `Test Core` runs it). No public export changed, so no importer of this package owes a test.

## Patch round 1 (head `b16b25977`)

- `packages/services/service-settings/README.md:110`: the built-in manifests table now gives `branding`'s highlight as "Organization name, logo, accent colour", matching the manifest description. The README ships (`files` lists it), and this PR renamed that field's label, so the old row would have been false. No other line in the file changed, and the file has no other "workspace".
- `origin/main` was merged at `f963d8e2b` (merge commit `5e6f67b58`, no conflicts). No rebase and no force-push.
- Re-verified at `b16b25977`: closure build VERDICT command-exit 0. The pin: `Tests 16 passed (16)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`: `Test Files 48 passed (48)`, `Tests 861 passed (861)`. `typecheck` exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date, because `packages/spec` moved on main's side. No ablation is owed, because no test reads the README.
- Derived gates at `b16b25977`, against merge base `f963d8e2b`: the same 63 commands. 62 exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` hit PREREQUISITE NOT MET and is measured by CI. `--ran` gives: 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED. CI on `b16b25977` is green: Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard and Check Changeset all succeeded.

## Acceptance notes

Not filed; recorded for whoever reads the ruling's follow-ups:

- `packages/plugins/organizations/src/membership-policy-gate.ts:327` (a boot refusal an operator reads) and `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx:127` repeat the membership help's "creating a workspace". They are outside this card's surface, the same noun family, and have no carrier here.
- `packages/services/service-settings/README.md:110`: fixed in patch round 1. The seat amended the file surface (`6238337817` on #24142).
- `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts`: the `SpecifierScopeSchema` doc says `tenant` is "per-project" in project-kernel mode. The service stores it per organization, and "project" was renamed environment in v5. The `category` describe also gives "Workspace" as its example. Both are comments only.
- `examples/app-showcase` `grp_workspace: { label: '工作区' }` is a navigation group meaning "work area" (My work, Review queue), not an organization or an environment. It is a different meaning and was left alone.
- Hub header vs card: the console groups Branding, Company and Localization under the `Workspace` category and renders it 「环境」, while those three are per-organization settings. That is for the console sibling (objectstack-ai/objectui#12851) to weigh.

- **Seat's append:** this is the first sighting of the retired-noun family beyond this card's surface (`membership-policy-gate.ts:327`, `authentication.mdx:127`, the spec describe drift). They are recorded here, and a second sighting opens one collector card over every position. The console hub category's carrier is objectstack-ai/objectui#12851.
